paite: Huan Samson bel Timnah ah ahohsuk a, Timnah ah Philistiate tanute lak ah numei khat ava mu hi.
heading: Samson Leh Timna Khua A Numei
english: Samson went down to Timnah, and saw a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines.

paite: Ahong paitouh nawn in anu leh apa ahilh hi. "Timnah khua ah, Philistiate tanute lak ah numei khat ka mu a; ka zi ding in hon pisak un," achi hi.
english: He came up, and told his father and his mother, saying, “I have seen a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines. Now therefore get her for me as my wife.”

paite: Huchi in anu leh apa'n akiang ah, "Na unaute tanute lak ah hiam, ka mipite lak a hiam numei om het lou hia? Zeksum louh Philistiate lak a zi ding na va zon maimah?" achi uhi. Samson in apa kiang ah, "Hon pisak mai in; ama'n hon lungkimsak mahmah ahi," achi hi.
english: Then his father and his mother said to him, “Isn’t there a woman among your brothers’ daughters, or among all my people, that you go to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines?” Samson said to his father, “Get her for me, for she pleases me well.”

paite: Himahleh anu leh apa'n, hiai TOUPA a pan ahi chih athei kei uh; ama'n Philistiate tung a phulakna ding hun lemtang zong lah ahi ngal a. Huai lai in Philistiate'n Israelte tung ah vai ahawm uhi.
english: But his father and his mother didn’t know that it was of Yahweh; for he sought an occasion against the Philistines. Now at that time the Philistines ruled over Israel.

paite: Huchi in Samson bel anu leh apa toh Timnah ah ahohsuk ua, Timnah a grephuan ava tung uhi. Ngai in, humpinelkai lun lai ana humham hi.
english: Then Samson went down to Timnah with his father and his mother, and came to the vineyards of Timnah; and behold, a young lion roared at him.

paite: TOUPA Kha atung ah nakpitak in ahong tung hi. Huchi in kelnou balnen bang mai in abalnen maimah hi; bangmah lah atawi ngal kei a. Himahleh athilhih anu leh apa ahilh kei hi.
english: Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on him, and he tore him as he would have torn a young goat with his bare hands, but he didn’t tell his father or his mother what he had done.

paite: Ahohsuk a, huai numei ahoupih hi. Ama'n Samson akipaksak mahmah hi.
english: He went down and talked with the woman, and she pleased Samson well.

paite: Anung in va pi ding in ahoh nawn a, humpinelkai luang en ding in ava pial hi. Ngai in, humpinelkai luang ah khuai hon leh azu ana om hi.
english: After a while he returned to take her, and he went over to see the carcass of the lion; and behold, there was a swarm of bees in the body of the lion, and honey.

paite: Huai ala a, apai nawn a, apai kawm in ane kawmkawm hi. Anu leh pa kiang atungtou a, amau leng apia a, amau leng ane sam uhi. Himahleh huai khuaizu humpinelkai luang a pan alak ahi chih ahilh kei hi.
english: He took it into his hands, and went on, eating as he went. He came to his father and mother and gave to them, and they ate, but he didn’t tell them that he had taken the honey out of the lion’s body.

paite: Huchi in huai numei kiang ah apa ava hohsuk a, huai ah Samson in ankuang alui hi. Huai ahihleh tangvalte hihdan ahi him hi.
english: His father went down to the woman; and Samson made a feast there, for the young men used to do so.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, amah amuhtak un, akiang a om ding in mi sawmthum api uhi.
english: When they saw him, they brought thirty companions to be with him.

paite: Samson in akiang uah, "Tu in thuhaksa hon dong ning e. Ankuanglui ni, ni sagih sung a na hon hilhchet theih ua, na theihkhiak theih uleh puanmalngat silh sawmthum ka hon pe ding.
english: Samson said to them, “Let me tell you a riddle now. If you can tell me the answer within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing;

paite: Himahleh na hon hilhchet theih kei uleh, puanmalngat silh sawmthum leh kikhenna puan sawmthum na hon piak ding uh ahi,” achi hi. Amau akiang ah, "Na thuhaksa gen dih ve le, ka na ngaikhe ding uh," achi uhi.
english: but if you can’t tell me the answer, then you shall give me thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing.” They said to him, “Tell us your riddle, that we may hear it.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Netu a pan nek ding hong pawt, hattak a pan thil khumtak hong pawt," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Out of the eater came out food. Out of the strong came out sweetness.” They couldn’t in three days declare the riddle.

paite: Ni thum sung in huai thuhaksa ahilhchian thei kei uh. Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in Samson zi kiang ah, "Ka kiang ua hiai thuhaksa hilhchetna puangkhe ding in na pasal kun in. Huchi lou in zaw nang leh na pa inkote ka hon hal ding uh. Ka neihsa uh la dia hon sam na hi kei maw?" achi uhi.
english: On the seventh day, they said to Samson’s wife, “Entice your husband, that he may declare to us the riddle, lest we burn you and your father’s house with fire. Have you called us to impoverish us? Isn’t that so?”

paite: Huchi in Samson zi ama ah akap a, "N'on it kei a, na hon ho zaw ve. Ka chite lah thuhaksa na dong ngal a, kei na hon hilhchian kei," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, ka nu leh pa leng ka hilh kei a; nang ka hon hilh dia hia?" achi hi.
english: Samson’s wife wept before him, and said, “You just hate me, and don’t love me. You’ve told a riddle to the children of my people, and haven’t told it to me.” He said to her, “Behold, I haven’t told my father or my mother, so why should I tell you?”

paite: A-ankuanglui uh, ni sagih sung teng ama ah akapkap hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in anget ngutngut ziak in ahilh khongkhong hi. Ama'n thuhaksa hilhchetna achipihte ava hilhta hi.
english: She wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted; and on the seventh day, he told her, because she pressed him severely; and she told the riddle to the children of her people.

paite: Ani sagih ni, nitum ma in huai khua a mite'n akiang ah, "Khuaizu sang a khumzaw bang ahia? Humpinelkai sang a hatzaw bang ahia?" achi uhi. Ama'n akiang uah, "Ka bawngla in lei let kei le uchin zaw, ka thuhaksa theikhe lou ding hi ve uchin," achi hi.
english: The men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down, “What is sweeter than honey? What is stronger than a lion?” He said to them, “If you hadn’t plowed with my heifer, you wouldn’t have found out my riddle.”

paite: TOUPA Kha atung ah nakpitak in ahong tung a, Ashkelon ah ahohsuk hi. Mi sawmthum ava that a, apuansilhte uh ahawksak a, kikhenna puante thuhaksa hilhchiante apia hi. Huchi in aheh mahmah a, apa inn ah apaitou hi.
english: Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on him, and he went down to Ashkelon and struck thirty men of them. He took their plunder, then gave the changes of clothing to those who declared the riddle. His anger burned, and he went up to his father’s house.

paite: Himahleh Samson zi pen akitenna ua theihpih a pang Samson lawmpa kiang ah zi ding in piak in a-om hi.
english: But Samson’s wife was given to his companion, who had been his friend.
